changes.to: Commercial floor-cleaning robot (sweeping, scrubbing, dust mopping); the catalog excludes cleaning robots, and it is not a humanoid.

Scope flag: C4 is a commercial floor-cleaning robot, which the catalog excludes, so the record sits in Misc instead of Humanoid; it is not a humanoid. AGIBOT's 2026-10-29 product brochure (pp. 48-49, C-series table) and its own Korean and Chinese product pages state 680 x 510 x 1015 mm, 140 kg, 1.2 m/s, scrubbing 3 h (dust mopping 8 h) on a 24 V 60 Ah battery with 1.5 h charging, 380 mm scrubbing width (600 mm with the side brushes), 540 mm squeegee, 25 L clean and 25 L dirty water, 1.6 L dustbin, up to 1,400 m2/h with a 95% debris pickup rate, 600 mm minimum aisle, 800 mm turning radius, 25 kg downforce and under 65 dB(A); the docking station holds 4 L, refills at 5-8 L/min, drains at 4-8 L/min and draws up to 1,200 W. Positioned for subway stations, factory warehouses, hotels, supermarkets, offices and showrooms, with access-control and elevator integration; AGIBOT states ISO 9001 for quality. No price is published on the maker's pages.
AGIBOT's commercial floor-cleaning robot for small-to-medium indoor spaces, sweeping, scrubbing and dust mopping in one pass from a docking station that charges it and refills and drains water.
